input becomes the protocol events; a button without a position goes to the last pointer
a refused send rejects with the client’s error

the video run is sent while connected; a grant goes to the client
dispose: the redial is cancelled, listeners dropped, the connection closed; a late connect is closed
a connect still running at dispose is closed when it succeeds
